svg.title: Характеры витрин — sosed.place и neighbro.place · 375×812
svg.text: одна механика, один кит: слева b-sosed на тёмной земле, справа b-neighbro на светлой · ночной бриф 2026-09-20

g.text: tonight? I will bring a thermos.

it — not us, not a filter.
Messages are encrypted on the devices.

here we go, a six again

A QR sets the point for whoever scans it.
Say the first thing — they will hear.
